title: Successful login redirects user to /new-area
description: Verifies that a user can log in with valid email/password and is redirected to the authenticated dashboard.

title: Invalid password shows authentication error on login page
description: Verifies that incorrect credentials do not log the user in and an error message is shown.

title: Empty email shows validation or blocks login submission
description: Verifies that the login form does not successfully submit when email is empty.

title: Empty password shows validation or blocks login submission
description: Verifies that the login form does not successfully submit when password is empty.

title: Whitespace-only inputs do not allow successful login
description: Verifies that whitespace-only email/password do not authenticate and an error/validation is shown.

title: Create a new tournament (happy path) and land on the tournament dashboard
description: Verifies an organizer can create a tournament with valid details and is taken to the tournament dashboard.

steps.description: Click the "Create Tournament" button or link
Type "Friday Night Cup" into the tournament name field
Select "Swiss" from the tournament type dropdown

title: Create tournament with Single Elimination type
description: Verifies tournament creation works when the organizer selects Single Elimination as the type.

steps.description: Click the "Create Tournament" button or link
Type "Weekend Knockout" into the tournament name field
Select "Single Elimination" from the tournament type dropdown

title: Tournament creation validation: missing required tournament name
description: Verifies submitting the create tournament form with a missing required field shows a validation error message.

steps.description: Click the "Create Tournament" button or link
Select "Magic: The Gathering" from the game dropdown
Select "Swiss" from the tournament type dropdown

title: Tournament creation validation: missing required game
description: Verifies the create tournament form prevents submission when the game is not selected and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Click the "Create Tournament" button or link
Type "No Game Selected Event" into the tournament name field
Select "Swiss" from the tournament type dropdown

title: Tournament creation validation: missing required tournament type
description: Verifies the create tournament form prevents submission when the tournament type is not selected and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Click the "Create Tournament" button or link
Type "Type Missing Event" into the tournament name field

title: Add a new round to a tournament from the tournament dashboard (happy path)
description: Verifies an organizer can add a round from the tournament dashboard and sees it listed afterward.

steps.description: Click the "Create Tournament" button or link
Type "Rounds Test Tournament" into the tournament name field
Select "Swiss" from the tournament type dropdown
Select "Round 1" (or "1") from the round number dropdown
Type "50" into the round duration/minutes field

title: Round creation validation: invalid round configuration shows an error
description: Verifies adding rounds with an invalid configuration is blocked and an error message is shown.

steps.description: Click the "Create Tournament" button or link
Type "Invalid Round Config Tournament" into the tournament name field
Select "Swiss" from the tournament type dropdown
Type "0" into the round duration/minutes field

title: Round creation validation: missing required round fields shows an error
description: Verifies round creation requires required fields and shows a validation message when they are missing.

steps.description: Click the "Create Tournament" button or link
Type "Missing Round Fields Tournament" into the tournament name field
Select "Magic: The Gathering" from the game dropdown
Select "Single Elimination" from the tournament type dropdown

title: Advance round successfully and view newly generated pairings
description: Verifies an organizer can advance the tournament to the next round and the UI shows the new round and its generated pairings.

steps.description: Click on a tournament in the dashboard list to open its tournament dashboard

title: Advance round shows pairings section for the new round
description: Verifies that after advancing a round, the page displays a visible pairings area/list for the newly created round.

steps.description: Click on a tournament in the dashboard list to open its tournament dashboard

title: Round list updates to include the newly advanced round
description: Verifies advancing a round adds the next round to the visible rounds list/navigation on the tournament dashboard.

steps.description: Click on a tournament in the dashboard list to open its tournament dashboard

title: Prevent advancing round when insufficient players are registered
description: Verifies the UI blocks round advancement and shows an error when there are not enough registered players.

steps.description: Click on a tournament in the dashboard list that has insufficient registered players

title: Insufficient players error does not advance the round
description: Verifies that after the insufficient players error appears, the visible current round does not change.

steps.description: Click on a tournament in the dashboard list that has insufficient registered players

title: Show conflict/warning when trying to advance a round with existing pairings
description: Verifies the UI shows a conflict or warning message when pairings already exist for the next round (or current round) and advancement is attempted again.

steps.description: Click on a tournament in the dashboard list that already has pairings generated for the current/next round

title: Conflict/warning message is visible and round does not duplicate
description: Verifies that when the conflict/warning is shown, the UI does not create an extra duplicate round entry.

steps.description: Click on a tournament in the dashboard list that already has pairings generated for the current/next round

title: Join a public tournament from Discover as an authenticated user
description: Verifies an authenticated player can join a tournament from Discover and sees a join confirmation.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the main navigation/menu
Click the "Participar" button on a visible tournament card

title: Cancel join from the join-required path
description: Verifies a player can open the join confirmation modal and cancel without completing the join.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the main navigation/menu
Click the "Participar" button on a visible tournament card
Click the "Cancelar" button in the confirmation modal

title: Join confirmation modal can be dismissed via close control
description: Verifies the join confirmation modal can be dismissed using a close control without proceeding.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the main navigation/menu
Click the "Participar" button on a visible tournament card
Click the "Cerrar" (X) control on the confirmation modal

title: Attempting to join from Discover when logged out triggers login requirement messaging
description: Verifies the user is prompted to log in when attempting to join, by confirming login page prompt is shown after a join attempt flow begins.

steps.description: Click on "Logout" in the main navigation/menu
Click on "Discover" in the main navigation/menu
Click the "Participar" button on a visible tournament card

title: Discover page is accessible and shows tournament cards with participation actions
description: Verifies the Discover page loads and presents join actions for public tournaments after login.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the main navigation/menu

title: Login with invalid credentials from the join-required path shows an error
description: Verifies invalid login attempt shows an error message, supporting the join flow that requires authentication.

title: Player reports a valid match result from 'Minha Mesa' and sees confirmation
description: Verifies a logged-in player can report a valid match result from the New Area dashboard and receives a visible confirmation.

steps.description: Click the button/link to report match results in "Minha Mesa"

title: Player submits match result and sees standings/dashboard update indicator
description: Verifies that after submitting a result from 'Minha Mesa', the dashboard shows a visible success state and some visible updated match status indicator.

steps.description: Click the button/link labeled "Reportar Resultado" / "Report Result" (or equivalent) for the current match

title: Player attempts to report invalid scores and sees validation error
description: Verifies score validation prevents submitting an invalid match result from 'Minha Mesa' and shows a visible error message.

steps.description: Click the button/link to report match results in "Minha Mesa"
Verify text "Erro" / "Error" or "Pontuação inválida" / "Invalid score" is visible

title: Player attempts to submit empty result fields and sees required-field message
description: Verifies that submitting without providing required score fields shows a visible required/validation message.

steps.description: Click the button/link to report match results in "Minha Mesa"

title: Filter Discover list to Active tournaments
description: Verifies that selecting the Active status filter updates the tournament list accordingly.

title: Filter Discover list to Concluded tournaments
description: Verifies that selecting the Concluded status filter updates the tournament list accordingly.

title: Apply filters that yield no results shows empty state
description: Verifies that when filters match zero tournaments, an empty state message is displayed.

steps.description: Select an option that is unlikely to have results (for example, "Concluded")
Select a game option that results in zero matches (choose any available game option that empties the list)
Verify text "No tournaments found" is visible

title: Clear filters restores tournament list
description: Verifies that clearing applied filters returns the discover list to an unfiltered state.

title: Combine Status and Game filters narrows results
description: Verifies that using multiple filters together refines the list of discoverable tournaments.

steps.description: Select any available game option from the game options list

title: Filters persist while staying on Discover page
description: Verifies that selected filters remain applied after interacting with the page content (without leaving the route).

steps.description: Scroll to the bottom of the tournament list

title: Access Unified Dashboard and open a tournament card (authenticated)
description: Verifies an authenticated user can reach the unified dashboard and open a tournament card to enter a tournament dashboard.

steps.description: Click on the first visible tournament card in the dashboard list

title: Unified Dashboard shows both organizer and participant sections (authenticated)
description: Verifies the unified dashboard renders key sections for organized events and participations for an authenticated user.

title: Access My Area and verify matches/tournaments list is visible (authenticated)
description: Verifies an authenticated user can view the My Area page and see their matches and tournaments list.

steps.description: Click the "My Area" / "Minha Área" navigation item

title: My Area: click a match item (if present)
description: Verifies a user can click a match from My Area to attempt navigation to match details (presence-based).

steps.description: Click the "My Area" / "Minha Área" navigation item
Click on the first visible match item in the matches list

title: New Area: quick access to "Minha Mesa" is visible (authenticated)
description: Verifies the unified dashboard exposes a quick action entry point for "Minha Mesa".

title: Login validation: invalid credentials show an error and stay on login
description: Verifies invalid login attempts do not grant access and display a visible error on the login page.

title: View global rankings list on the Rankings page
description: Verifies that the global rankings page loads and displays a visible rankings list.

title: Change game filter updates the global rankings list
description: Verifies that changing the game filter updates the visible rankings list content/state.

steps.description: Select a different game option from dropdown

title: Filter selections persist while staying on the Rankings page
description: Verifies that after changing the game filter, the selection remains visible without leaving the page.

steps.description: Select a different game option from dropdown

title: Empty-state handling when filters yield no rankings
description: Verifies that the page shows a clear empty-state message when no rankings are available for a selected game.

steps.description: Select a game option that is likely to have no results from dropdown
Verify text "Try another filter" is visible
